claims.head: Picky against trigger-happy
claims.body: The Blues wait for good looks, but the Jets settle for hopeful ones. St. Louis is the league’s best for shot quality, and Winnipeg is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. The more dangerous chances should be the Blues’.

Winnipeg: a 5.9% chance of scoring on the average shot, 29th of 32. Style fingerprint, this season blended with last, 7 and 7 games this season.

claims.head: The Jets’ edge in the power play
claims.body: The Jets are around the middle of the league for the power play, and the Blues are one of the worst. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one. These two rarely give each other power plays, so special teams may not get much of a say.

STL.head: The matchup suits the Blues
STL.body: St. Louis has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage, while Winnipeg will be without Morrissey. The Jets’ way back in is a penalty kill that holds up.
